title: Técnico Químico
description:
Responsibilities / Tasks

O que você fará:

  • Formulador de produtos químicos
  • Responsável por todos os procedimentos de fabricação de acordo com os requisitos da GMP e da Anvisa.
  • Seguir todas as instruções de batelada conforme as ordens individuais de produção.
  • Deve rotacionar o estoque de matérias-primas com base no princípio "primeiro que entra, primeiro que sai".
  • Relatar todas as leituras dos tanques antes do início do turno.
  • Verificar todos os produtos químicos antes do início de uma batelada para garantir a disponibilidade de matérias-primas e itens de embalagem, e comunicar-se com o pessoal de compras quando os níveis de estoque estiverem baixos.
  • Obrigatório verificar o retrabalho e os produtos devolvidos diariamente e utilizar as quantidades corretas nas bateladas.
  • Obrigatório levar amostras das bateladas ao laboratório para testes de Controle de Qualidade (Q.C.) antes da embalagem.
  • Obrigatório garantir que todos os operadores de máquinas estejam enchendo os recipientes corretos com o produto correto.
  • Garantir que as entregas a granel estejam conectadas ao tanque de armazenamento correto antes de descarregar.
  • Obrigatório carregar e descarregar caminhões e verificar se as informações na documentação (material, data/hora de entrega, pesos, etc.) estão corretas.
  • Obrigatório manter a área de Batelada organizada e limpa.
  • Realizar pequenas manutenções nos equipamentos.
  • Encher os produtos produzidos nos silos.
  • Rotulagem e armazenamento – Imprimir, rotular, embalar, armazenar e identificar corretamente os pacotes utilizados durante o processo de produção; - Enchimento de produtos.
  • Verificar o sistema para pedidos, entregas, saldos de materiais e produtos acabados.
  • Seguir todas as instruções e procedimentos de segurança.
  • Deve conhecer e seguir as normas e políticas internas de Qualidade, Meio Ambiente e Saúde e Segurança Ocupacional, visando aumentar o comprometimento e o engajamento nos projetos e programas desenvolvidos pela empresa.

Your Profile / Qualifications

Quem você é:

  • Técnico em Química com experiência na indústria química, farmacêutica ou similar.
  • Operação de produtos químicos; Operação de empilhadeira; Sistemas de batelada;
  • Abastecimento e descarregamento de silos de produção; Conhecimento em análises químicas de rotina (pH, densidade, aspecto, titulação, entre outras);
  • Operações de Tratamento de Efluentes;
  • Conhecimento em processos de rotulagem e enchimento de produtos líquidos. Conhecimentos básicos em informática, conhecimento em Word, Excel e análises laboratoriais.

description:

Job Description

The Digital and IT Site Leader is responsible for defining and implementing the site’s digital master plan, aligning it with essential business needs. This role involves leading a multi-functional digital team at the site and collaborating with GBS service lines to achieve site operational targets, ensure compliance, and generate substantial value creation results.

Key Responsibilities:

Define and Drive the Digital Master Plan for the Site (30% of capacity)

  • Actively participate as a member of the site leadership team.
  • Develop the digital master plan for the site in line with the Business Unit (BU) and the site’s compelling business need.
  • Ensure the master plan includes strategic interventions to optimize data architecture, enabling predictive analytics and value acceleration. Coach teams on the successful delivery of these programs/projects.
  • Reflect the digital master plan in the portfolio tool (1PT) to track progress and outcomes.
  • Lead regular digital portfolio reviews with key stakeholders from the site, central BU organization, and Global Business Services (GBS).
  • Collaborate with GBS service line leaders/Single Points of Contact (SPOCs) to achieve the site’s operational targets, drive business growth and value, and enable the progression of the Integrated Work System (IWS) framework's digital pillar.
  • Lead the coordination of the multi-functional digital team’s master plan.
  • Act as a thought leader and provide critical input to the master plan to ensure outcomes are achieved.
  • Ensure alignment with P&G’s “Smart from the Start” strategy for site expansion projects.

Lead and Deliver Value for the Site and/or Category (40% of capacity)

  • Lead at least one top digital project per year to enable site and/or category value.
  • Conduct at least one digital pilot per year leveraging P&G Data Architecture, AI, and Manufacturing Data Flow (MDF) architecture, bringing AI use cases to life to deliver business value.
  • Anticipate and align future Digital Solutions/Investment opportunities with BU leadership and service lines, including data loss opportunities as part of loss elimination efforts.

Ensure Operational Excellence and IT Controls - Audits Ready Every Day (20% of capacity)

Manage the Site Data and Technology Budget (10% of capacity)

About P&G:

P&G is the largest consumer packaged goods company in the world. We have operations in over 75 countries, with 65 trusted brands that improve lives for 5 billion consumers worldwide. This brings many advantages, including the opportunity for our employees to enjoy a diverse and rewarding lifelong career filled with new and exciting challenges.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. Our mission of Equality and Inclusion is: “Everyone valued. Everyone included. Everyone performing at their peak”.

We seek the most diverse talent so that we always know how to innovate to exceed the expectations of our consumers. We offer meaningful challenges from day one and effective and constant training. Thus, we bring to bear the strengths of our employees and develop them to become phenomenal leaders, reaching the highest levels of management. Working with us is the best opportunity to do what you love, with constant challenges and to be recognized for its results. More than that, it's the ideal opportunity to help us touch and improve billions of lives in our world.

For over 175 years, we have built some of the world’s most successful brands, including Always, Ariel, Aussie, Clearblue, Downy, Gillette, Head and Shoulders, Oral-B, Pampers, Pantene and Vick.

Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

The group's key figures are approximately: Turnover of 6.5 billion euros, more than 940 laboratories in 62 countries and around 62,000 employees.

Job Description

SUMMARY OF POSITION AND OBJECTIVES:

The Release Manager role will be responsible for deploying builds across the environment, on-boarding new environment , Handling transversal projects and create release management related document and share release plan with the stakeholders

  • Manage risks and resolves issues that affect release scope, schedule and quality
  • Facilitate release activities across all releases, mainly with ensuring quality, timely deployments across environments
  • Maintains the release schedule for all core services and ensure alignment across key partners and vendors.
  • Coordinate release content and effort based on the service request backlog, pending service requests, third party applications, or operating system updates
  • Communicate all key project plans, commitments, and changes including QA plans, schedule, and scope changes.
  • Conduct Release Readiness reviews, Milestone Reviews, and Business Go/No-Go reviews with stakeholders
  • Produce Deployment, Run Books and Implementation Plans
  • Participate in CAB meetings to present Production changes (RFCs)
  • Lead and co-ordinate the Go-Live activities including the execution of the deployment Plans and checklists.
  • Weekly Release Reporting with Program release manager.
  • Own and continually improve the release process by documenting release issues and developing plans to improve processes, able to recommend continuous improvements viz: automation .
  • Comfortable in interacting with people across hierarchical levels for smooth project execution. Enjoys managing complex projects involving challenges.
Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

  • English Language is mandatory to collaborate in a global environment, including writing, speaking and presenting.
  • Understanding of Continuous Delivery and Continuous Integration (CD/CI) pipelines
  • Good understanding of cloud deployment, preferably Azure and Agile practice
  • Knowledge on Deployment tool like Octopus
  • Knowledge on MS Project, Excel-Macros
  • Document Management for adhere to Audit Compliance process is an added advantage
  • 4 to 5 years of relevant release and deployment management experience
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional work teams towards task completion
  • Demonstrated effective leadership and analytical skills
  • Strong in troubleshooting and organizational skills and ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Platforms : Windows, Linux.

  • 5 years of work experience in a technical role (e.g., software engineering, solutions consultant, etc.) or equivalent technical experience.
  • Experience speaking at technology conferences, blogging/writing technical articles with an existing follower base, or contributing to a popular open source project.
  • Experience in the areas of Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence or GenAI, including ability to guide developers on the use of these technologies.
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese and English fluently to support the local and global developer community.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in coding/engineering beneficial to the technical domain.
  • Ability to take ownership of solutions and exert influence without authority.
  • Ability to work globally and collaboratively in a team environment, be diplomatic, and influence technical practitioners, stakeholders, and globally distributed teams.
  • Ability to share technical knowledge and information with others.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate in Spanish fluently to support the community in the LATAM region.

About the job

Passionate people are everywhere at Google. In Developer Relations, we get excited to collaborate and connect with the communities that love technology as much as we do. Part community manager and part developer advocate, Developer Relations Engineers collaborate with developers at conferences and online, and advocate for developers interests internally at Google. Not afraid to be hands-on, you write sample code and client libraries as well as participate in developer forums and support queues to troubleshoot and debug coding problems developers encounter. Internally, you work with product engineering teams to improve our products by conveying feedback from developers, reviewing API designs and testing new features. Chrome, Android, App Engine, HTML5 as well as our core Google Apps and Ads APIs are just some of the platforms you promote and support.
With your technical expertise, you drive strategy around fostering a community of developers who work with Google technologies. An ardent advocate for these developers, you represent their voice internally to our Product Managers and serve as their Google support in application development and technology implementation.

As a Cloud Developer Relations Engineer, you’ll join a team of Practitioners that empathize deeply with external technical communities, and advocate on their behalf to the Google Cloud Product and Engineering teams, ensuring that our products are built to meet the community's needs and that they provide the best possible user and developer experiences. You’ll work to raise awareness of Cloud technologies and methodologies within our technical communities through enablement and inspiration, and you’ll drive strategy around Google Developer Relations efforts for specific communities and products.

Responsibilities

  • Advocate for the community internally and influence Google Cloud product strategy by working with cross-functional teams. Support an inclusive work environment.
  • Synthesize feedback in order to drive continuous improvement to Google Cloud Platform products and to the overall experience of the platform by technical practitioners.
  • Participate in technical communities as a practitioner having, or developing, deep understanding of that community’s needs. Build and foster an external community ecosystem of influencers, meetups, experts that amplify messages and extend the reach.
  • Represent the needs of relevant technical communities throughout the entire product lifecycle, including input on design discussions, customer zero testing, launch, post-launch updates.
  • Work with Product and Engineering teams to define product strategies and to craft narratives around new products and features.

title: Project Engineer
description:
The Project Engineer position is responsible for assisting and supporting Senior Project Managers and Project Directors in representing Roeslein & Associates in all matters involving the prospecting for and the proposing, negotiating, securing, and implementation of our projects and will serve as the customer's single point of interface throughout each of his/her projects.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist Business Development in developing estimates and schedule for proposals; presenting proposals to existing and potential customers; and developing and maintaining existing customer relationships; and assist Business Development in developing new customer relationships.
  • Assist Project Managers responsible for customer management and communication, including change orders, engineering details, invoicing, and project schedule updates.
  • Assist Project Managers responsible for project financials, including reviewing job cost details, reviewing actuals vs. estimated costs, invoicing, and monthly projections.
  • Assist Project Managers responsible for project team management and communication, including kick-off meetings, project progress meetings, and lessons learned.
  • Prepare all proposal documents for all RFQs (proposal, estimate, schedule, clarifications & exceptions, etc). Estimates and proposals must meet client RFQ requirements for format and content.
  • Manage, interpret and enforce existing customer contracts and terms of all project subcontracts.
  • Establish a complete and detailed project schedule for each project; a thoroughly documented scope of work for the project; and a project budget in accordance with Roeslein’s cost accounting system.
  • Plan for and secure any required subcontractors, including (but not limited to) engineers, consultants, fabricators, electrical and mechanical contractors, clerks, schedulers, administrative support, etc.
  • Implement bidding process for project subcontractors to obtain the most competitive prices.
  • Assist with negotiation and authorization of all terms and conditions of project subcontracts, and authorize subcontract changes.
  • Oversee, control and authorize all project-related expenditures.
  • Provide monthly project cost projections as compared with the project’s estimated budget; and monthly reports of project cost projections.
  • Present the contracted scope of work to the project team and ensure complete understanding and acceptance of responsibilities.
  • Provide thorough communication with the project team.
  • Travel domestically and internationally ranging from 10-50% per year and up to four (4) weeks duration.

OTHERS DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Promote a positive working environment in order to achieve the organization’s goals.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Work is performed in an office and uncontrolled atmosphere. Exposure to harsh conditions—such as: dust, fumes, chemicals, hazardous materials, noise, and varying weather and temperatures—for short periods of time is possible. Must be able to travel to jobsites both domestically and internationally; living accommodations in some foreign assignments may not meet expected U.S. standards. All employees are required to follow safety standards and wear all personal protective equipment in designated areas.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to safely and successfully perform the essential responsibilities and functions of a Project Manager and are not meant to be all-inclusive. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential responsibilities and functions of the job.

KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering.
  • Courses in the area of Project Management.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

OTHER DESIRABLE ATTRIBUTES:

  • It is preferred a minimum of Three (3) years of professional experience in a technically related field is required. It is strongly preferred that Two (2) years of that experience be as a Project Engineer.
  • A certified Project Management Professional (PMP) is preferred.
  • Demonstrated history of in strategic and tactical goal setting and attainment.
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, and excellent presentation skills are required.
  • Strong organization, leadership, negotiation, and delegation skills are required.
  • Strong financial background including operations budget development, cost control, and capital spending justification.
  • Working knowledge of contract laws, jobsite safety procedures, and purchasing practices.
  • Specific estimating skills for engineering, construction management, and mechanical/electrical construction services is a must.
  • Working knowledge of common scheduling concepts such as CPM, PERT, Gantt charts, resource loading, etc.
  • Skilled in the use of scheduling software tools and must be able to create schedule reports for all audiences.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills are required.
  • Computer skills and an in-depth knowledge of Microsoft Windows based programs are required.
  • Requires effective time management skills, personal conduct, and change management abilities.
  • Must have a valid driver license.
  • Ability to effectively interact with co-workers, clients, vendors, and other business contacts.
  • Must comply with Roeslein & Associate’s core values for the safe and efficient operation of the business and maintain sound relationships among and with employees.

This is an in-person position, and applicants must be comfortable commuting to Arujá/SP. The role is primarily office-based, however, occasional travel to jobsites both domestically and internationally may be required.

title: Graduate Customer Success Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Graduate Customer Success Manager role at Canonical

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Graduate Customer Success Manager role at Canonical

The role of a Customer Success Manager at Canonical
Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective to reduce risk and churn, facilitate the adoption of new products or services and support expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. Through a clear understanding of their customer's objectives, the CSM can activate a large range of internal and external capabilities to alleviate any pain point, align expectations, as well as help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.
We are growing our Customer Success team to continue offering thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open source infrastructure and applications.
This role is a first step in the CSM organisation. Although you will primarily focus on the Tech segment, including the store customers, you will also have a portfolio assigned. Ubuntu is chosen by thousands of new users every month. Our responsibility is to ensure the best user experience for them through problem-solving, onboarding, enablement and value realisation all the way to success. Collaborating with other teams and participating in campaign efforts, you will connect with a diverse set of users of Canonical products and identify our future champions.
Location: This role will be based remotely worldwide.
What your day will look like

  • A strong focus on supporting customers by finding solutions to ticket requests.
  • Enrich documentation about problem solving, Q&A, onboarding materials.
  • Drive campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.
  • Identify high potential as well as high risk customers from newly onboarded users or customers
  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Engage with your portfolio of customers to ensure risk identification
  • Collect feedback from customers and format them for review by the product team
What we are looking for in you
  • Customer-facing experience
  • An empathetic individual with a natural drive to help others
  • Passion for technology, infrastructure and Ubuntu in particular is a must
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Strong organisational skills, ability to structure and constantly update documentation
  • A team player capable of interacting with all departments internally
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

  • Multi software-solution and multi-industry experience is a plus

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer phenomenal benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

We are seeking dedicated therapists to join our team at Buddha Spa. If you have experience in body and facial therapies, we invite you to apply and help us provide relaxation and well-being to our clients.

Apply exclusive protocols for body and facial therapies, including massages (relaxing, shiatsu, sports, Ayurvedic), lymphatic drainage, skin cleansing, and more. Your goal is to deliver specialized techniques that promote relaxation and well-being.

Qualifications and Requirements

We welcome professionals with degrees or technical training in Massage Therapy, Physiotherapy, Aesthetics, Naturology, Naturopathy, Integrative Therapies, Biomedicine, Nursing, Physical Education, Pharmacy (with specialization in Aesthetics), Nutrition, Psychology, or Occupational Therapy. Contracts are formalized through MEI (Microentrepreneur Individual) agreements, ensuring legal security and formal recognition, in accordance with salon partnership laws.

Training

Training will be conducted at Buddha College in São Paulo or another designated location, with morning and afternoon sessions. During training, services are unpaid, but travel support is provided, deducted from earnings after starting work.

You will have a fixed day off during the week and one fixed Saturday off per month.

Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

Somos uma equipe apaixonada e comprometida com a geração de valor não só da nossa empresa, mas principalmente dos nossos clientes e parceiros, por isso buscamos profissionais que tenham esse espírito no seu DNA.

DESCRIÇÃO SUMÁRIA:

Responsável por acompanhar o gerenciamento da obra conforme escopo contratado, sendo um "representante" e defendendo os interesses do cliente, garantindo um relacionamento sólido e de longo prazo. Dar visibilidade ao cliente quanto ao cumprimento do contrato entre o cliente e construtora, sendo capaz de propor soluções estratégicas e mitigação de riscos. É responsável pela capacitação e desenvolvimento de sua equipe para garantir a excelência na execução dos projetos.

ATRIBUIÇÕES:

  1. Gerenciamento, fiscalização e acompanhamento direto das obras e monitoramento do contrato de construção, observando o cumprimento dos acordos celebrados, adotando como referenciais os indicadores de desempenho estabelecidos;
  2. Coordenação das atividades multidisciplinares visando atender ao escopo, projeto, planejamento, controle de custos, qualidade dos serviços, segurança, compliance, administrativo, comunicação, análise de riscos, bem como gestão dos processos existentes e atendimento pós-obra (assistência técnica);
  3. Responsável pela liderança da equipe de engenharia assegurando o desenvolvimento, acompanhamento e alinhamento entre todos os stakeholders, promovendo comprometimento e entregas diferenciadas;
  4. Coordenação de todas as interfaces técnicas, bem como acompanhamento dos processos estabelecidos;
  5. Gestão do cliente quanto a administração das expectativas e suas necessidades (dentro do escopo de atuação), sendo os “olhos” do cliente e responsável pelos apontamentos e andamento da obra;

title: Senior Design System Designer - SAP Concur
description:
Senior Design System Designer - SAP Concur

At SAP, we enable you to bring out your best. Our company culture is focused on collaboration and a shared passion to help the world run better. How? We focus every day on building the foundation for tomorrow and creating a workplace that embraces differences, values flexibility, and is aligned to our purpose-driven and future-focused work. We offer a highly collaborative, caring team environment with a strong focus on learning and development, recognition for your individual contributions, and a variety of benefit options for you to choosefrom.

Join SAP Concur’s Design Systems team and help shape the future of scalable, accessible enterprise experiences. Move beyond maintaining a component library — architect how global teams design, build, and innovate across multiple SAP product areas.
You’ll create foundational patterns and practices that empower product teams worldwide to deliver exceptional experiences, improving how people travel, work, and manage expenses.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

In this role, you will:

  • Shape and grow a multi-platform design system used by millions globally.
  • Design foundational components, patterns, and floorplans that streamline complex enterprise experiences.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration with designers, engineers, and product managers worldwide.
  • Champion inclusive, accessible, and human-centered design practices at every level.
  • Mentor teams to create with quality, speed, and purpose while promoting design system best practices.
  • Analyze system usage and feedback (both quantitative and qualitative) to guide continuous improvements.
  • Educate and advocate across the organization to promote system adoption and scale impact.
  • Deliver measurable impact by simplifying complex systems, making them intuitive, empowering, and accessible for users everywhere.

KEY RESPONSABILITIES:

  • Design System Leadership: Develop, evolve, and maintain a scalable, enterprise-grade design system supporting multiple products and platforms.
  • Component, Pattern, and Floorplan Design: Specify reusable UI components, UX patterns, and page-level floorplans with deep documentation and accessibility baked in.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with global designers, framework developers, product managers, and stakeholders to ensure smooth system implementation.
  • Accessibility and Inclusivity: Embed WCAG accessibility standards and inclusive design principles throughout every system element.
  • Education and Evangelism: Create training, documentation, workshops, and internal communication to increase system literacy and adoption.
  • Data-Driven Continuous Improvement: Evaluate feedback and usage data to prioritize and deliver high-impact system enhancements.
  • Mentorship and Support: Guide designers in system thinking, provide hands-on support for product teams, and cultivate a culture of design excellence.
  • Quality and Standards Stewardship: Maintain the highest quality standards for system assets and ensure consistent, scalable UX across SAP Concur platforms.

WHAT YOU BRING:

  • Proven experience building, evolving, and scaling enterprise-grade design systems across web and mobile platforms.
  • Deep systems thinking and expertise in designing scalable UI/UX foundations for complex products.
  • Strong collaboration skills working across global, multidisciplinary teams.
  • Expertise specifying and documenting components and patterns within Figma (or equivalent tools).
  • Deep commitment to accessibility (WCAG 2.1/2.2) and inclusive design.

KEY QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Design: Visual, Graphic, Interface, Industrial, Media, or related fields
  • Strong UX/UI Design Experience, with significant experience focused on design systems for enterprise environments
  • Figma Mastery: Expert in developing and managing scalable component libraries
  • Impactful System Portfolio: A portfolio or demo showcasing your design system work isrequired for consideration

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (NICE TO HAVE):

  • Experience supporting large-scale, multi-product design systems in a global organization.
  • Passion for creating accessible, user-friendly solutions that serve diverse audiences.
  • Strong mentorship and coaching experience with junior or early-career designers.
  • Skilled at solving ambiguous, complex problems and turning them into clear, actionable goals.
  • Familiarity with technical constraints for web and mobile development across enterprise platforms.

Help us drive the future of enterprise UX by making complex systems simple, intuitive, and empowering — at global scale.

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP,you can bring out your best.

title: Senior Audit Manager, FinCrime (LACC)
description:
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by Crypto, ultimately contributing to every individual's freedom.

OKX began as a crypto exchange giving millions of people access to crypto trading and over time becoming among the largest platforms in the world. In recent years, we have developed one of the most connected Web3 wallets used by millions to access decentralized crypto applications (dApps).

OKX is a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets on a reliable platform that seamlessly connects with global banking and payments. In the last year, OKX has expanded into new markets including Australia, Brazil, Netherlands, Singapore and Turkey, with plans to launch in the US, Belgium and the UAE.

We are deeply committed to shaping a fairer, more transparent and accessible society through blockchain technology. This is why we publish proof of reserves monthly, and continue to ship new innovative security features.

About the Opportunity:

The Senior Audit Manager, FinCrime (LACC) will manage the internal audit function for financial crimes, including Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF), sanctions compliance, fraud prevention, and other financial crime-related activities. This role ensures that the organization's financial crime risk management and compliance frameworks are robust, effective, and aligned with regulatory expectations.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and implement the annual audit plan for financial crimes, ensuring alignment with the organization's strategic goals and regulatory requirements.
  • Advise senior management on financial crime-related risks, control gaps, and regulatory trends.
  • Act as a subject matter expert for financial crimes audit, providing strategic insights and guidance.
2. Audit Execution
  • Lead end-to-end audits covering AML/CTF, sanctions compliance, fraud detection, and other financial crime programs.
  • Assess the effectiveness of policies, procedures, controls, and systems designed to mitigate financial crime risks.
  • Monitor compliance with local and global regulatory requirements (e.g., AML, FATF, OFAC sanctions, etc.).
  • Ensure that audits are conducted efficiently, with clear and actionable recommendations provided to management.
3. Team Management
  • Foster and contribute to a culture of collaboration, excellence, and continuous improvement within the audit team.
  • Coordinate with colleagues located globally, as well the potential to manage performance of small teams to ensure the delivery of high-quality audit reports.
4. Stakeholder Management
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including Compliance,Risk Management, Legal, and external regulators.
  • Participate in governance forums, presenting audit findings and updates related to financial crimes risk.
  • Provide proactive insights into emerging financial crime risks and regulatory changes.
5. Regulatory and Industry Knowledge
  • Stay up to date with regulatory developments, industry best practices, and emerging threats in financial crime risk management.
  • Ensure the organization's financial crime audit approach aligns with regulatory expectations and global standards.
6. Reporting
  • Prepare and deliver comprehensive, timely, and accurate audit work papers and reports to senior management and the Audit Committee.
  • Track and validate the remediation of audit findings to ensure timely resolution.
What We're Looking For:

Experience: Strong experience (8+ years) in internal audit, including leadership roles in Financial Crimes at a leading global financial institution, fintech, or Big 4 firm. Experience in crypto, digital assets, or blockchain is a plus..

Expertise: Deep knowledge of AML, CTF, and sanctions regulatory expectations for financial services, and cutting-edge audit methodologies. Familiarity with data analytics and emerging audit technologies is highly desirable

Leadership: Proven ability to lead and inspire cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Communication: Exceptional ability to articulate complex ideas to diverse audiences, including regulators and senior leadership

Certifications: ACAMS required.CPA, CIA, or similar credentials are also preferred. Advanced certifications (e.g., CISA, CFA) are a plus.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. Law degree or equivalent preferred.

  5. Avaliar e implementar práticas de segurança na operação, com foco em processos de manejo seguro de produtos químicos e gestão de resíduos.
  6. Conduzir avaliações de risco e elaborar planos de resposta a emergências.
  7. Projetar, implementar e otimizar sistemas de lavagem de gases para remoção de poluentes gasosos, como cloro e outros compostos tóxicos.
  8. Monitorar a eficiência dos lavadores de gases, ajustando parâmetros operacionais para maximizar a remoção de contaminantes e atender às normas ambientais.
  9. Participar na elaboração de projetos de investimento em novas tecnologias e equipamentos, visando a modernização e eficiência da planta.
  10. Conduzir estudos de viabilidade técnica e econômica para novas iniciativas de produção.
  11. Realizar análises estatísticas de dados de produção visando identificar tendências e oportunidades de melhoria.
  12. Implementar metodologias de melhoria contínua, como Six Sigma e Lean Manufacturing, para otimização de processos e redução de desperdícios.
  13. Capacitar a equipe operacional sobre boas práticas de fabricação (BPF), segurança e manuseio de produtos químicos.
  14. Supervisionar as atividades diárias da equipe, garantindo que os processos sejam realizados de acordo com as normas estabelecidas.
  15. Colaborar com as áreas de manutenção, engenharia e logística para assegurar a operação integrada e eficiente da planta.
  16. Trabalhar em conjunto com o departamento de vendas para atender às necessidades específicas dos clientes e otimizar a produção conforme a demanda.
  17. Multiplicar treinamentos.
  18. Fazer parte da equipe de apoio às emergências.

Requisitos:

  1. Experiência em gestão de sistemas de lavagem de gases, com conhecimento em tecnologias e processos de controle de poluição do ar.
  2. Conhecimento profundo dos princípios de reações químicas, termo e cinética química.
  3. Familiaridade com normas de segurança e regulamentações ambientais (ex: ABNT, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, Prodir e Sassmaq).
  4. Habilidade em softwares de simulação de processos e ferramentas de análise estatística.
  5. Experiência com sistema integrado TOTVS.

Formação necessária:

Graduação em Engenharia Química ou área correlata, com registro ativo no CRQ.

Ensino superior.

What Canonical offers
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals.   • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: C# .NET Engineer - Work from home
description:
A remote team never felt so close Join our LATAM team and stay connected while working remotely. We value our team members and candidates interested in our vacancies. Enjoy fun activities like coffee breaks, tech talks, and games with our developers and management teams during your stay with us.

Who needs micromanagement? For us, communication is key, so we focus on working autonomously, with honesty, and respecting diversity. Micromanagement is not part of our corporate values.

Work-life Balance Your well-being is our priority with our People Care team, available from day one to offer support and help with anything from needing someone to talk to, requesting time off or a holiday, or using any of our offered benefits.

Additionally, our Accounts Management team ensures a smooth and effective stay with our clients, fostering a harmonious relationship with both the client and the project.

Here you'll get:

  • USD Salary compensation.
  • 100% remote work but if you feel like connecting with people you can visit co-working spaces all over LATAM allowing you to expand your professional network.
  • Paid time off according to your country’s law without affecting your monthly salary to ensure that you have plenty of time to rest and recharge.
  • Your country’s national holidays allow you to celebrate important events and traditions with your loved ones.
  • Sick or medical leave when needed so that you can take a day off to take care of your health and have well-being without worrying about work.
  • Refundable annual credit for you to spend on your favorite perks.
  • Team-building activities such as coffee breaks, tech talks, and after-work gatherings with your Nearsure colleagues, to feel close to our community.
  • A day off during your birthday week to enjoy with your family and friends, ensuring that you have a chance to make memories on your special day.

About the project:

We are seeking a Senior FullStack .NET Engineer who has deep knowledge and experience building full-stack applications in a production environment. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated expertise in leading the technical direction of their team. This position will report to the Senior Engineer Manager for Next-Gen Experience.

You will be able to:

  • Lead a team of highly experienced Software Engineers as a technical lead.
  • Guide and mentor team development efforts toward successful project delivery.
  • Architect and implement new React components and frontend applications.
  • Document architectural designs through diagrams and logical flows within Miro or similar tools.
  • Build and test new designs, formulations, materials, or systems for compliance with quality and/or performance standards.
  • Test new applications and services in a variety of environments.
  • Determine operational feasibility by providing analysis, problem definition, requirements, solution development, and proposed solutions.
  • Provide information by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing development and service issues.
  • Work side-by-side with key Principal and Distinguished Engineers to design and build scalable solutions.

What will help you succeed in this role:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ Years of Software Engineering experience.
  • 6+ Years of experience working with React (preferred), or Angular.
  • 6+ Years of experience working with TypeScript.
  • 4+ Years of experience working with C# .NET (preferred), or Java.
  • 4+ Years of experience working with ES6.
  • 4+ Years of experience working with Frontend Application State Management (Redux, MobX, etc).
  • 4+ Years of experience working with REST.
  • 4+ Years of experience working with GraphQL.
  • 4+ Years of experience working with AWS (preferred), or Azure willing to learn AWS.
  • 3+ Years of experience working in a Technical Leadership role.
  • Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

Here's what you can expect from our hiring process:

  • We'd love to discuss your experience in an interview with our recruiters.
  • If all goes well, we'll arrange a technical interview with our top developers to evaluate your skills.
  • If you advance to the next stage, you'll have a chance to meet our client and potentially become a part of our amazing team!

Would you like to work alongside top Latin American talent?

Work remotely from Latin America for US clients with Nearsure, a staff augmentation company that values people and culture. Gain cross-cultural expertise and improve your English skills with daily communication in English.

We're excited to have you on board and can't wait to learn more about you.

  • Preparar programas de treinamento sobre segurança do trabalho, incluindo programas de conscientização e divulgação de normas de segurança, visando ao desenvolvimento de uma atitude preventiva nos associados quanto à segurança do trabalho;

  • Colaborar com a CIPA em seus programas;
  • Levantar e estudar estatísticas de acidentes do trabalho, doenças profissionais e do trabalho, analisando suas causas e gravidade, visando à adoção de medidas preventivas;
  • Coordenar SIPAT, dando diretriz à CIPA organizando as atividades e recursos necessários;
  • Desenvolvimento e análise de indicadores SESMT.

  • Experiência em Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho;

Nossa História
A C&A é uma das maiores redes de varejo de moda no mundo. De origem holandesa, foi fundada em 1841 pelos irmãos Clemens e August, cuja união das iniciais de seus nomes resultou na marca C&A.
Nessa trajetória de sucesso, em 1976 foi inaugurada a primeira loja no Brasil, no Shopping Ibirapuera, em São Paulo. Atualmente, a C&A está presente em todos os estados do território nacional com mais de 330 lojas. Claro que, desde a sua primeira unidade, muita coisa mudou, mas a filosofia de trabalho continua a mesma: entendemos as pessoas, suas necessidades, evoluções, sua relação com a moda e as tendências, e traduzimos isso em uma experiência vibrante e completa. Esse é o nosso jeito de criar combinações para impulsionar e inspirar o pertencimento de cada pessoa.
A gente se encontra na C&A
Por aqui, acreditamos que nós podemos impactar positivamente as pessoas para que sejam o que desejam ser por meio da moda. Cada associada e associado traz consigo a alegria, a vibração e a energia para transformar o varejo e a moda no Brasil.
Somos muitos e únicos, cada um trabalhando para dar vida ao nosso propósito.
Além disso, há experiências que só a C&A pode oferecer: ambiente leve, informal e divertido; valores e compromissos inegociáveis para a sociedade; desenvolvimento profissional no varejo; e conexão com uma marca de renome e que entrega resultados consistentes.
Nós vestimos as mudanças! Esse é o nosso DNA!

description:
Operadora (or) de Equipamento e Movimentação

Buscamos uma (um) Operadora (or) de equipamento e movimentação para a fábrica de Itapetininga.

Se você tem atitude de dono, acredita na liderança pelo exemplo e tem interesse em fazer parte de um ambiente colaborativo, que fomenta a inovação e acredita na diversidade, o seu ambiente é aqui na Dexco!

Inscreva-se e venha fazer parte da nossa jornada de transformação.

Sobre a Unidade de Negócio Madeira...

Nós somos a maior produtora de painéis de madeira industrializada do Hemisfério Sul e oferecemos soluções em painéis de madeira, pisos laminados, vinílicos e rodapés. Somos comprometidos com a qualidade, design, sustentabilidade e tecnologia, ofertamos aos nossos clientes e consumidores um portfólio de alternativas para os seus ambientes.

Responsabilidades:

  • Retirar e movimentar resíduos da área (borra de resinas, catalisador, formol), utilizando empilhadeira e/ou trator e encaminhá-los para a área específica, como aterro ou incineração;
  • Retirar caçambas plásticas para a reciclagem e caçamba biológica para o aterro, das áreas da fábrica, utilizando caminhão;
  • Prestar assistência à fábrica, como suprir as áreas com tambores vazios, utilizando empilhadeira;
  • Preencher check list do caminhão, trator, caterpiller;
  • Providenciar a limpeza dos veículos e solicitar manutenção, quando necessário;
  • Retirar das áreas os materiais identificados com etiqueta de descarte;
  • Retirar cinzas da caldeira, utilizando caminhão, levando-as para a área de resíduos (específico);
  • Organizar, limpar, movimentar e retirar resíduos da área, e/ou da fábrica, utilizando a Caterpiller, Varredeira e o/ou Caminhão;
  • Coletar os lixos nas diversas áreas, utilizando o trator;
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas, a critério de seu superior imediato;
  • Zelar pelo atendimento do SGQ, SGA, 5S, SIGA e segurança do trabalho e contribuir com os programas de melhoria contínua;
  • Curso de Operador de Empilhadeira;

Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica para o colaborador e seus dependentes;
  • Assistência odontológica para o colaborador e seus dependentes;
  • Seguro de vida para o colaborador e seu cônjuge (a adesão é opcional);
  • TotalPass: Plataforma que permite ao associado frequentar diversas academias parceiras;
  • Convênio Farmácia: Garante a compra de medicamentos por um valor mais acessível;
  • De Bem com a Mente: Programa que promove o cuidado com a saúde mental;
  • Pronto Atendimento Pessoal: Programa de apoio que ampara e orienta em assuntos nas áreas: financeira, psicológica, jurídica e serviços sociais;
  • Gestar Juntos: Programa para as gestantes da Dexco;
  • Auxílio-creche: Apoio financeiro para o responsável legal na mensalidade de creches;
  • Refeição: Vale-refeição para colaboradores alocados no Escritório Central;
  • Transporte: Vale-transporte ou fretado;
  • Participação de Lucros e Resultados (PLR);
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Empréstimo Fundação Itaúsa Industrial;
  • Empréstimo consignado;
  • UniDexco: plataforma online com conteúdo, cursos e treinamentos;
  • Clube de Parcerias Dexco;
  • Loja Dexco: desconto na compra de produtos selecionados.

Alinhado a nossa cultura, temos como objetivo tornar a Dexco um lugar mais inclusivo, onde os colaboradores possam ser quem realmente são e sejam valorizados pelas suas diferenças. Buscamos talentos com diferentes características e que queiram estar conosco nessa jornada de transformação!

A Hexagon

A Hexagon é líder global em soluções de realidade digital, combinando sensores, software e tecnologias autônomas. Estamos colocando os dados para trabalhar para aumentar a eficiência, a produtividade, a qualidade e a segurança em aplicações industriais, de manufatura, de infraestrutura, do setor público e de mobilidade.

Nossas tecnologias estão moldando os ecossistemas de produção e relacionados às pessoas para se tornarem cada vez mais conectados e autônomos – garantindo um futuro escalável e sustentável.

A divisão de Mineração da Hexagon resolve desafios de minas superficiais e subterrâneas com tecnologias comprovadas de planejamento, operações e segurança.

A Hexagon (Nasdaq Estocolmo: HEXA B) tem aproximadamente 24.000 funcionários em 50 países e vendas líquidas de aproximadamente US$ 5,5 bilhões. Saiba mais em hexagon.com e siga-nos @HexagonAB.

Esta vaga envolve atendimento a clientes, oferecendo suporte técnico em soluções tecnológicas de ponta voltadas para o setor de mineração, especificamente sistemas de controle de operação e frota, monitoramento de fadiga de operadores, anti-colisão e teleoperação de equipamentos. Formação Acadêmica

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Administração ou áreas relacionadas.

Principais Áreas de Responsabilidade

  1. Atender clientes com soluções como gerenciamento de frotas, anti-colisão, anti-fadiga, intervenção veicular, perfuração, teleoperação, fragmentação, alta precisão, telemetria, alerta de pessoas, entre outros.
  2. Utilizar tecnologias como bancos de dados (SQL, Oracle, Postgres, MongoDB, SQLite), relatórios, dashboards, redes, monitoramento de ativos e linguagens de programação (Delphi, C#, Ruby, C++, Java, C, ASP, Visual Basic, Python, JavaScript, React, entre outros).

  10. Oferecer suporte in loco quando necessário.
  11. Reportar melhorias de produto.
  12. Elaborar relatórios de atendimento técnico.
  13. Investigar problemas em computadores de bordo/tablets, incluindo substituição de hardware ou diagnóstico de software.
  14. Substituir módulos, antenas, cabos e sensores, além de limpeza de painéis solares, quando aplicável.
  15. Realizar inspeções de média complexidade nas máquinas de construção, interpretando esquemas elétricos ou inspeções visuais, para dimensionar componentes para sistemas de automação 3D.
  16. Realizar entregas técnicas, treinamentos e acompanhamento operacional em campo, garantindo autonomia do cliente.
  17. Conduzir demonstrações técnicas e análises de falhas, visando otimizar a operação dos sistemas.
  18. Ministrar treinamentos avançados e realizar estudos de produtividade para demonstrar ganhos.
  19. Diagnosticar problemas mecânicos e realizar reparos, testes de desempenho e manutenção corretiva.

Cursos/Treinamentos/Conhecimentos Específicos

  • Montagem, instalação e manutenção de hardware automotivo.
  • Eletricidade automotiva ou similares.
  • Informática básica (Windows/Linux, Word, Excel).
  • Noções de redes de computadores.
  • Conhecimentos em elétrica DC e leitura de diagramas elétricos.
  • Desejável conhecimento em sistemas Android.
  • Experiência com suporte técnico e atendimento ao cliente.
  • Experiência em mineração subterrânea é um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento em SQL e bancos de dados (Postgres, Oracle, SQL Server).
  • Conhecimento em SQL Server Reporting Services.
  • Sistemas operacionais Windows/Linux.
  • Redes de computadores e serviço IIS da Microsoft.

Experiência Anterior em Segmentos

  • Mineração
  • Automotivo e equipamentos pesados
  • Telecomunicações

  • Capacidade de análise e resolução de problemas.

  • Consciência da importância de cumprir prazos.

Nossa visão vai além da construção de edifícios; buscamos construir parcerias sólidas e rigorosas.

Juntos, podemos construir um futuro melhor! Conheça os requisitos para fazer parte desta equipe:


Main responsibilities

  • Elaborar, implementar e manter o PSST – Plano de Segurança, Saúde e Meio Ambiente do Trabalho;
  • Elaborar, implementar e manter o PAE – Plano de Atendimento a Emergência;

  • Assessorar a área de produção no planejamento de processos produtivos, visando a segurança dos colaboradores;

  • Elaborar e implementar calendário de campanha de saúde e segurança do trabalho;
  • Iniciar ações para prevenir ocorrência de quaisquer acidentes ou incidentes relativos a SST;
  • Avaliar planos de içamento de cargas (planos rigging) e autorizar e supervisionar as atividades;
  • Avaliar e monitorar as subcontratadas cujas atividades impactem diretamente nos procedimentos e indicadores do projeto;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das Normas Regulamentadoras;
  • Coordenar, juntamente com o Administrativo, o processo de fornecimento de EPI aos colaboradores;
  • Coordenar investigação de incidentes com identificação das causas e definição de medidas de prevenção e controle;

  • Acompanhar os resultados de SST do planejamento estratégico da obra durante o ano e definir ações para atendimento às metas estabelecidas.

Join to apply for the Gerente Sênior - Portfólio de Ativos de Crédito role at EY

Na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira única. Afinal, It’s yours to build .

Na EY-Parthenon para Serviços Financeiros (EY-P FSO), apoiamos clientes do segmento financeiro em estratégias, transações, fusões, aquisições e desinvestimentos, ajudando a reimaginar seus ecossistemas e portfólios para um futuro melhor.

#FSOEY #EY-P

A oportunidade está disponível para contratação híbrida em São Paulo.

Seu papel

Como Gerente Sênior de Portfólio de Ativos de Crédito, você desempenhará papel vital na tomada de decisões estratégicas em transações de ativos de crédito, contribuindo para o crescimento e eficiência da empresa. Suas responsabilidades incluem:

  • Conduzir análises de due diligence de portfólios de ativos de crédito, incluindo recebíveis e crédito não performado, identificando riscos, oportunidades e tendências de mercado;
  • Avaliar e otimizar processos de transações, assegurando eficiência e conformidade;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para desenvolver estratégias de transação que maximizem valor e minimizem riscos;
  • Liderar e desenvolver equipe de analistas, promovendo aprendizado contínuo e inovação;
  • Apresentar relatórios e recomendações à alta administração e stakeholders, baseados em análises rigorosas e insights estratégicos.

Por que você?

Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade é sua:

  • Experiência em instituições financeiras, consultorias, empresas de investimento ou gestoras;
  • Experiência em operações de cessão de crédito, recebíveis ou securitização;
  • Habilidades de liderança e gestão de equipes;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação;
  • Capacidade de relacionamento em diferentes níveis, trabalho sob pressão, diversidade de produtos e clientes;
  • Conhecimentos em análise de dados e ferramentas de BI, com foco em ativos de crédito;
  • Graduação em Administração, Finanças, Contabilidade ou área relacionada;
  • MBA ou pós-graduação será um diferencial;
  • Inglês avançado.

Oferecemos

Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa, benefícios educacionais, Gympass, PLR e mais. Conheça nossos benefícios clicando aqui .

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, atuando em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, com presença em mais de 150 países. Aqui, você viverá experiências excepcionais, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para seu desenvolvimento.

Acreditamos na força da diversidade de pessoas e ideias. Segundo o Great Place to Work 2022, somos a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+ no Brasil, e a 2ª melhor para Mulheres e Pessoas Pretas. Participe de nossos programas e iniciativas que promovem a equidade.

Quer se sentir desafiado, motivado e valorizado? Inspire mudanças e deixe um legado. Faça parte do nosso time na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor!

Somos um dos maiores empregadores do país, com 76 mil colaboradores e colaboradoras que trabalham diariamente pela missão de oferecer alimentos de qualidade a preços justos para o abastecimento de comerciantes, transformadores e consumidores finais.
Com infraestrutura moderna e eficiente, o Atacadão disponibiliza aos seus clientes uma variada gama de produtos, com cerca de 10 mil itens, nas categorias de laticínios, hortifrúti, bebidas, doces e biscoitos, higiene pessoal, limpeza, bazar, produtos da linha pet, automotivo, entre outros, além de serviços como padaria, açougue e frios e fatiados.
O Atacadão marca presença no ambiente digital por meio do seu e-commerce, com um próprio canal de vendas online mais direcionado a transformadores, comerciantes e empreendedores de pequenas, médias e grandes empresas, pela possibilidade de adquirir volumes maiores de itens, parcerias com aplicativos de entrega que atendem ao consumidor final, e também o Meu Atacadão, aplicativo que permite que os clientes encontrem ofertas diferenciadas enquanto fazem suas compras nas lojas físicas.
Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta & biodiversidade.

title: OPERADOR PRODUCAO I
description:
Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras globais de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos, guiados por valores sólidos, um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos com um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas anualmente, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está presente em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas globalmente. Nossos valores incluem ética, integridade, humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Descrição da vaga

  1. Carregar big bags de 1 tonelada, garantindo que o produto chegue ao cliente na embalagem correta e organizada;
  2. Contar os Big Bags no caminhão para assegurar a produção correta ao cliente;
  3. Ajudar na limpeza de armazéns e na produção, sempre que solicitado, para manter um bom fluxo de trabalho;
  4. Ajudar no recebimento de embalagens e na montagem dos blocos de big bags, respeitando o FIFO do planejamento industrial;
  5. Coletar amostras de produto acabado dentro do caminhão para verificar a qualidade;
  6. Lacrar os big bags junto aos operadores de carregamento, garantindo a integridade do produto;
  7. Preparar os caminhões na linha de produção, organizando a carga para maior agilidade;
  8. Manter o padrão 5S na organização de embalagens e garantir o FIFO;
  9. Preencher o checklist de carregamento para assegurar um produto organizado e correto ao chegar ao cliente;
  10. Preparar as Ordens de Produção e organizar a fila de carregamento para evitar erros;
  11. Chamar veículos para carregamento, otimizando o processo;
  12. Realizar rotulagem de etiquetas, garantindo a entrega correta e confiável do produto;
  13. Lacar as lonas dos caminhões após o carregamento para prevenir adulterações;
  14. Auxiliar na montagem da carga conforme padrão, melhorando a performance;
  15. Atuar como biqueiro na liberação de carga para enchimento dos big bags;
  16. Gerenciar o pátio, organizando caminhões e chamando-os conforme o plano de produção;
  17. Realizar limpeza do maquinário, conforme procedimentos, para preservar a produtividade;
  18. Realizar limpeza interna de máquinas, se apto a trabalho em altura e espaço confinado;
  19. Executar retrabalhos em caso de falhas no processo, como ajustes de peso ou qualidade;
  20. Verificar e comunicar a falta de caminhões ao PCP, para providências;
  21. Se treinado em NR-20, acompanhar o abastecimento de diesel das pás carregadeiras;
  22. Ajudar na implementação do 5S no armazém de matéria-prima e embalagens, promovendo ambiente mais limpo, organizado e seguro.

Qualificações e informações adicionais

  • Conhecimento em Fertilizantes;
  • Habilidade na identificação de falhas no produto.

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todos possam prosperar. Valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Essa oportunidade também é destinada a pessoas com deficiência (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro do nosso propósito. Somos apaixonados por criar valor justo e sustentável para nossos negócios, colaboradores, parceiros, comunidades e meio ambiente.

title: Desenvolvedor(a)
description:
Quem somos?

A LEVTY é uma empresa de serviços em transformação digital corporativa. Nossos especialistas possuem alto nível técnico, sendo boa parte desse conhecimento formado e consolidado no dia a dia do trabalho.

Somos um dos principais parceiros estratégicos da SYDLE e atuamos fortemente com a plataforma SYDLE ONE, uma das mais utilizadas por grandes empresas para gestão de processos.

Além disso, temos um ambiente propício para o crescimento profissional, contando com um clima descontraído e flexível.

Ficou claro que pessoas são a alma do nosso negócio, não é?! Somos uma empresa jovem, com uma equipe altamente escalável e que cresce de forma sustentável.

O que é preciso para entrar no nosso time?

  • Paixão por tecnologia aliada ao potencial técnico! Para nós, essa combinação é um dos maiores diferenciais para fazer parte de uma equipe de alto desempenho.
  • Lógica de programação e flexibilidade em lidar com novas tecnologias. Temos abertura tanto para profissionais experientes como para os que estão no início da carreira.
  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharias ou afins são as que mais buscamos.

O que você fará em seu dia a dia?

Temos um dia a dia bem dinâmico. Não trabalhamos somente com desenvolvimento e codificação, os times são auto organizados e todos os membros têm oportunidade de participar de toda a esteira de construção de um Software, desde o levantamento e especificação de requisitos, definição de arquitetura, modelagem, implementação, testes, garantia de qualidade, até a implantação e manutenção de sistemas. Você poderá se desenvolver em várias áreas!

O trabalho é realizado em times colaborativos, totalmente focados em atingir os melhores resultados para cada cliente. Utilizamos metodologias ágeis e nossos Engenheiros e Engenheiras de Software possuem perfil full stack, trabalhando na plataforma SYDLE ONE.

As tecnologias utilizadas são: Javascript, Elasticsearch, React, API REST, entre outras.

Gostou da oportunidade? Entenda nossa seleção.

Ao cadastrar seu currículo, ele será analisado pelo nosso RH e, caso seja selecionado, entraremos em contato com você para informar sobre a nossa seleção - que ocorrerá em três etapas (Teste de Lógica, Bate-papo RH e Bate-papo Técnico). Portanto, verifique se seu contato no currículo está atualizado e confira sempre seu e-mail e telefone :)

Uma LEVTY para todos!

Entendemos que a inovação só nasce com a diversidade e sabemos da importância de cada um para a construção de um ambiente de trabalho autêntico e plural. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas, sem exceção, são abertas para todas as pessoas, e nossa seleção será adaptada de acordo com a necessidade de cada um!

Confira nossos benefícios!

Uma cesta de benefícios pensada para você!

Sabemos que pessoas diferentes possuem necessidades diferentes. Por isso, não há sentido em engessar nossos benefícios! Nos preocupamos em proporcionar um pacote com incentivos variados, para que cada colaborador usufrua da forma mais adequada à sua realidade!

Nossas opções:

description:
Join to apply for the Graduate Customer Success Manager role at Canonical

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Graduate Customer Success Manager role at Canonical

The role of a Customer Success Manager at Canonical
Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective to reduce risk and churn, facilitate the adoption of new products or services and support expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. Through a clear understanding of their customer's objectives, the CSM can activate a large range of internal and external capabilities to alleviate any pain point, align expectations, as well as help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.
We are growing our Customer Success team to continue offering thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open source infrastructure and applications.
This role is a first step in the CSM organisation. Although you will primarily focus on the Tech segment, including the store customers, you will also have a portfolio assigned. Ubuntu is chosen by thousands of new users every month. Our responsibility is to ensure the best user experience for them through problem-solving, onboarding, enablement and value realisation all the way to success. Collaborating with other teams and participating in campaign efforts, you will connect with a diverse set of users of Canonical products and identify our future champions.
Location: This role will be based remotely worldwide.
What your day will look like

  • A strong focus on supporting customers by finding solutions to ticket requests.
  • Enrich documentation about problem solving, Q&A, onboarding materials.
  • Drive campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.
  • Identify high potential as well as high risk customers from newly onboarded users or customers
  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Engage with your portfolio of customers to ensure risk identification
  • Collect feedback from customers and format them for review by the product team
What we are looking for in you
  • Customer-facing experience
  • An empathetic individual with a natural drive to help others
  • Passion for technology, infrastructure and Ubuntu in particular is a must
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Strong organisational skills, ability to structure and constantly update documentation
  • A team player capable of interacting with all departments internally
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Na BEP, somos mais do que uma distribuidora de vendas; somos uma força motriz que impulsiona empreendedores a atingir novos patamares. title: Data Protection Analyst (1785)
description:
Join Our Team at Hy Cite Enterprises, LLC

At Hy Cite Enterprises, LLC, we are proud to be a global leader and innovator in the direct selling industry, with more than 50 years of sustained growth and meaningful impact across 7 countries.

Our people are the heart of our success. We embrace the unique experiences, cultural backgrounds, and perspectives that each team member brings—because we know that diversity drives innovation and connection. By fostering an inclusive environment built on trust, support, and authenticity, we’re able to better understand and serve our distributors and customers around the world.

We are looking for our next: Data Protection Analyst in Barueri, São Paulo, Brazil

What The Role Involves

The Data Protection Analyst will be a valued collaborator across Legal, IT, and Information Security functions, supporting global data privacy and cybersecurity standards including LGPD, CPRA, GLBA, and NYDFS Reg 500. This person will engage with teams across regions and disciplines to help embed legal requirements into everyday practices through project support, training, and thoughtful documentation.

Key Responsibilities Include

  • Support business and IT projects by reviewing proposed data use, identifying privacy and cybersecurity requirements, assisting with Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), and helping resolve identified risks.
  • Partner with Legal, IT, and Compliance to ensure regulatory requirements are considered early in project planning—helping prevent costly rework, missed deadlines, and scope changes.
  • Support vendor oversight by maintaining an inventory of required privacy and security terms in standard contracts, tracking approved deviations, and identifying which vendors process personal data (PII). Coordinate with Legal to flag gaps and support ongoing vendor risk management.
  • Triage and respond to incoming questions about data privacy and security; maintain clear documentation of actions and decisions.
  • Monitor and assess digital tracking practices (e.g., website cookies) for compliance with global requirements.
  • Support privacy governance tools (e.g., BigID, OneTrust) by helping ensure legal requirements are reflected in data inventories, records of processing, and risk documentation.
  • Support responses to Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs) and related compliance reporting.
  • Help develop and deliver internal training to promote awareness and understanding of data privacy and legal requirements related to cybersecurity.
  • Follow all legal and compliance policies and report any potential issues or breaches.

What We’re Looking For

  • A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited 4-year institution.
  • 1–3 years of relevant experience, ideally in privacy, data governance, or security roles.
  • Working knowledge of regulations such as LGPD, CPRA, and NYDFS Reg 500.
  • Familiarity with tools like OneTrust or BigID is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between legal, business, and technical teams.
  • Organized and detail-oriented; able to manage deadlines and work with cross-functional teams.
  • CIPP certification is a plus.
  • Fluency in English is required; fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is strongly preferred.

Ready to Apply?

If you're passionate about protecting data, collaborating across global teams, and growing your career in a purpose-driven environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of our inclusive team.

Com mais de dez anos de história, o PicPay é um ecossistema completo de serviços financeiros e não-financeiros que tem como objetivo atender as necessidades diárias de milhares de pessoas e negócios, tornando-se a sua principal conta do dia a dia.
